description: Implement Issue #17 in the frontend SPA: a localized relative-time 'last updated' display, a manual refresh button, and conditional background auto-refresh polling that runs ONLY when the selected season is predictable AND the bracket currently has an in-progress series. Polling pauses when the tab is hidden (Page Visibility API) and resumes with an immediate refetch when visible. Refreshes are flicker-free (no loading spinner, scroll position and selected series preserved) and a failed refresh keeps the previous data while surfacing the error unobtrusively. This is the core of Issue #17 and satisfies all three acceptance criteria. The change is confined to the frontend workspace plus its unit tests.
steps: Create a small PURE, localized relative-time helper, e.g. frontend/src/relativeTime.ts exporting formatRelativeTime(fromIso: string, now: Date, lang: Lang): string. Use Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(lang==='ja'?'ja':'en', { numeric: 'auto' }) to render 'N minutes ago' / 'n分前'. Pick sensible buckets: < 60s => seconds ('just now' threshold acceptable), minutes under an hour, hours, else days. Guard invalid/future timestamps gracefully (clamp negative diffs to 0). Keep it dependency-free and side-effect-free so it is unit-testable.

Create a reusable auto-refresh hook, e.g. frontend/src/useAutoRefresh.ts exporting a named interval constant AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS = 60000 (document the 60s choice: matches Issue #17's suggestion and stays well under the ~15min backend cache TTL while giving in-progress fans timely updates) and a hook useAutoRefresh({ enabled, intervalMs, onRefresh }). Behavior: when enabled, setInterval(onRefresh, intervalMs); clear the interval on unmount, when enabled flips false, and when document.hidden; subscribe to document 'visibilitychange' - pause (clear) when hidden and resume when visible, firing an immediate onRefresh on becoming visible. Use refs so a changing onRefresh identity does not reset the timer. Must be safe under jsdom (guard typeof document).

In frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx extend BracketState or add adjacent state so the UI can distinguish a background refresh from the initial load: keep the existing 'loading'|'error'|'ready' union for the FIRST load, and add fields on the 'ready' state (or sibling state) for isRefreshing: boolean and refreshError: string | null. The initial useEffect keyed on [season] keeps its current behavior (full loading state, resets selectedSeriesId).

Add a background refresh function in HomePage, e.g. refresh() that calls getBracket(season) WITHOUT setting status back to 'loading': on success replace bracket + usedFallback, clear refreshError, update a lastUpdatedTick; on failure keep the existing bracket and set refreshError to a localized message. Do NOT reset selectedSeriesId on a background refresh (preserve the selected series - criterion 2). Guard against races/stale seasons (ignore a resolved refresh whose season no longer matches, e.g. via a captured season or a ref).

Compute the polling predicate: pollingEnabled = isPredictable(season) AND state.status==='ready' AND state.bracket.series.some(s => s.status === 'in_progress'). Pass it as `enabled` to useAutoRefresh with intervalMs=AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS and onRefresh=refresh. This guarantees past/results-only seasons never poll (criterion 1) and that polling only happens with a live in-progress series.

Render a 'last updated' line and a manual refresh button near the bracket header (only when state.status==='ready' && bracketStarted). Show formatRelativeTime(state.bracket.updatedAt, now, lang) via a localized label like t('refresh.lastUpdated', { relative }). Make the relative text re-render as time passes: keep a `now` state updated on a lightweight 1-minute setInterval (or recompute on each poll) so 'n分前' advances without a manual reload. The manual refresh button calls refresh(), is disabled and shows an 'updating' affordance while isRefreshing is true, and uses a localized label t('refresh.button')/t('refresh.updating').

Surface a background-refresh failure unobtrusively (criterion 3): when refreshError is set, render a small inline notice (reuse the subtle .app__notice styling, NOT the full-screen .app__status--error path) with a localized message like t('refresh.error'); it must not replace the bracket. The next successful refresh clears refreshError.

Ensure flicker-free behavior (criterion 2): the background refresh path must never set status:'loading' (which would unmount the bracket and reset scroll), and must not reset selectedSeriesId. A subtle 'updating…' indicator (text/spinner) is acceptable; a full loading screen is not.

Add i18n keys in frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts: extend the MessageKey union and BOTH the en and ja MESSAGES tables with: 'refresh.lastUpdated' ('Last updated: {relative}' / '最終更新: {relative}'), 'refresh.button' ('Refresh' / '更新'), 'refresh.updating' ('Updating…' / '更新中…'), 'refresh.error' (e.g. 'Could not refresh - showing the last loaded data.' / '更新できませんでした。直前のデータを表示しています。'). Keep EN and JA in sync (the i18n unit test asserts key parity).

Add unit tests colocated in the frontend workspace: (a) frontend/src/relativeTime.test.ts covering EN and JA for seconds/minutes/hours/days and the future/zero-diff guard; (b) frontend/src/useAutoRefresh.test.ts(x) using vi.useFakeTimers and @testing-library/react renderHook to assert: polls onRefresh every interval only when enabled; does NOT poll when enabled is false (results-only / no in-progress series); clears the interval on unmount; stops when document.hidden is set and 'visibilitychange' fires, and fires an immediate refresh + resumes on becoming visible; (c) a HomePage-level test (frontend/src/pages/HomePage.test.tsx or extend App.test.tsx) that mocks ../api getBracket and asserts flicker-free transitions - the bracket stays mounted during a refresh, a failed refresh keeps prior data and shows the inline error, and the selected series id survives a refresh. Follow existing mocking patterns (vi.mock) and the jsdom setup in frontend/src/test/setup.ts.

Run `npm run build` and `npm test` from repo root and fix any type or test failures. Make an incremental git commit on branch feat/mlb-postseason-site referencing Issue #17 (e.g. 'feat(frontend): auto-refresh in-progress bracket with last-updated + manual refresh (Issue #17)'). Record the commit hash in findings.
acceptance_criteria: Criterion 1: a results-only season (e.g. 2024/2025) and a predictable season with NO in-progress series never start the polling interval (asserted in useAutoRefresh.test and/or HomePage test).

Criterion 2: a background refresh keeps the bracket mounted (no loading spinner), preserves the selected series id, and does not reset scroll (asserted via a HomePage test showing the bracket is not unmounted and selectedSeriesId persists across a refresh).
Criterion 3: a failed background refresh keeps the previous bracket data and shows an unobtrusive inline localized error, not a full error screen; a subsequent successful refresh clears it.
The 'last updated' line renders formatRelativeTime(Bracket.updatedAt) localized EN/JA and the manual refresh button triggers an immediate refresh and is disabled while in flight.
Polling interval is a documented named constant (AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS = 60000) and polling pauses when document.hidden and resumes (with an immediate refetch) on visibility.
All new user-facing strings exist in BOTH the en and ja i18n tables; the i18n key-parity test passes.
findings: Completed in commit fe3833e on branch feat/mlb-postseason-site. Added frontend/src/relativeTime.ts (pure localized Intl.RelativeTimeFormat helper, numeric:'auto', seconds/minutes/hours/days buckets, clamps invalid+future diffs to 'now'/'今') and frontend/src/useAutoRefresh.ts (exports AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS=60000; hook polls only when enabled, holds onRefresh in a ref so changing identity does not reset the timer, pauses on document.hidden and fires an immediate refetch + resumes on visibilitychange, clears on unmount/disable, jsdom-safe). Wired HomePage.tsx: added isRefreshing/refreshError/now state and a background refresh() that re-fetches via getBracket WITHOUT the 'loading' swap, keeps the selected series, guards stale seasons via a seasonRef, clears refreshError on success and sets a localized inline error on failure. pollingEnabled = isPredictable(season) && status==='ready' && some series in_progress -> passed to useAutoRefresh. Added a last-updated line (formatRelativeTime advances via a 1-minute setInterval) and a manual Refresh button (disabled + 'Updating…' + aria-busy while in flight). Inline failure uses .app__notice (not the full-screen .app__status--error path). i18n keys refresh.lastUpdated/button/updating/error added to BOTH en and ja tables (key-parity test green). CSS: .app__refresh bar + .app__refresh-button + .app__notice--refresh. Tests: relativeTime.test.ts (EN+JA across all buckets + future/invalid guard; verified ICU output e.g. ja '1 分前'/'昨日'), useAutoRefresh.test.tsx (fake timers: polls only when enabled, no poll when disabled, clears on unmount, pauses hidden + immediate refresh/resume on visible, stable timer across callback identity change), HomePage.test.tsx (last-updated+button render, flicker-free bracket stays mounted + selectedSeriesId survives refresh, failed refresh keeps prior data with inline notice/no alert and clears on next success). Verification: `npm run build` PASS (shared->backend->frontend->infra), `npm test` PASS (shared 22, backend 92, frontend 57, infra 8). Note: FEAT-003 (e2e + specs/README docs) remains per task.json.
